note: Reduced model: classical shot geometry only. The orientation features that are xGHub's contribution are not available from this pipeline.
domain: Open play, free kicks and corners. NO PENALTIES: xGHub contains none, so this model has never seen one. It puts a central shot from the penalty spot at about 0.20, which is right for open play from there -- the dataset's own shots at that distance and angle convert at 0.17 -- and wrong for a penalty, which converts around 0.76. Penalties need their own number, not this one.
